scenes.title: Twenty Paces East
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Wutong Lane, Qing, Zhou, and Hao check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: By the Stone Fountain
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, Qing and Hao spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but Zhou insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: The Famous Shortcut
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, Zhou leads the group straight back outside Mei's open café kitchen window at Courtyard Inn.

scenes.title: Shadow of the Clock Tower
scenes.summary: Joined by Peng at the municipal clock tower at noon, Qing and Hao watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Under the Bookshop Arch
scenes.summary: Meeting Song under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, Qing spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making Song gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: The Shaded Park Bench
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Wutong Lane, Hao places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of Courtyard Inn with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Opening the Small Envelope
scenes.summary: On the park bench, Qing, Song, and Hao break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Message at the Front Desk
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, Qing and Zhou find Chen holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
